title: Queensland Museum Kurilpa
geometryBasis: Standing Queensland Museum Kurilpa at South Bank, Brisbane, including the stepped concrete collection volumes, the full-height Grey Street Museum Garden, and the glazed street entrance with its attached approach to the Melbourne Street Overpass.
sectionBasis: The 36-point museum outline and eight overpass controls set the location and scale. The Arts Queensland conservation report defines the stepped gallery and collections volumes, the west garden opening and the later glazed entry.
limitations: The standing museum perimeter, main entrance point and bridge alignment are mapped. Upper setbacks, roof screens, planters, joints and service openings are proportioned from exterior and written evidence.
The conservation report establishes the full-height indoor-outdoor Museum Garden at Grey Street. Its bay divisions, planting and opening extents are estimates.
The glazed Melbourne Street entrance uses the surviving building form and an exact public-domain 2005 photograph. Reworked threshold, fascia details and the walk deck section are approximate.
The original Queensland Government elevation field is unmodified. The placement uses the Melbourne Street sidewalk datum and retains approximate contact across its different pedestrian levels.
